string: Smart Agri needs your location to provide accurate weather alerts and crop recommendations for your farm area.
Smart Agri uses background location to send timely weather alerts relevant to your farm.
Smart Agri uses the camera to photograph plant leaves for AI disease detection and treatment advice.
Smart Agri can access your photo library to analyze plant images for disease identification.
Smart Agri may save scanned plant images to your photo library.
Smart Agri uses the microphone to listen to your voice queries for the AI agricultural assistant.
Smart Agri uses speech recognition to convert your voice questions into text for the AI assistant, supporting English, Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, and Chinese.
